question.text: Under the SEBI AML framework, what is the prohibition on 'tipping off' regarding Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs)?

answer.text: Only the Principal Officer is prohibited from disclosing STR filing
Tipping off is prohibited only after the STR is filed
Intermediaries and all their directors, officers and employees are prohibited from disclosing that an STR is being reported, and this extends before, during and after submission
Tipping off is prohibited only to external parties, not within the organization

explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI Master Circular provides that intermediaries and their directors, officers and employees (both permanent and temporary) are prohibited from disclosing the fact that an STR or related information is being reported to FIU-IND. The prohibition applies before, during and after the submission of the STR. The Trap: Option B is partly correct but too narrow. The prohibition is not limited to the period after filing; it covers the entire lifecycle of the STR. Note: The prohibition covers both permanent and temporary employees of the intermediary.
